FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Which trading platforms is it compatible with? +

MetaTrader 4 & 5 via MetaApi and VELORA native Expert Advisors. Additionally, iOS and Android apps, and an open API for developers in future releases.

Will my old trade history be imported? +

Yes; automatic sync supports up to 12 months of account history, and manual entry is always available for special cases.

How is my broker account information protected? +

Investor passwords are encrypted at the field level with AES-256-GCM and never stored in plain text. All webhooks are verified with HMAC signatures, and access is protected by dual JWT and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC).

Is it suitable for prop traders? +

Yes; real-time monitoring of daily and total drawdown, profit targets, currency normalization across accounts, and instant alerts when approaching prop firm rule limits — designed specifically for prop trading challenges.

Can I export my data? +

Absolutely; CSV and PDF exports are available for all reports and data — your data always belongs to you.

Does the free plan have limitations? +

No; the free plan is free forever and activates without a credit card. Limitations only apply to the number of connected accounts and access to advanced analytics.
